model_annotation: The chart compares the negative log probability of per-specialty terms across different medical specialties for a base model and its fine-tuned versions. The horizontal axis lists the categories corresponding to different medical specialties - Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics - in that order, representing the different terms being evaluated. The vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and has a linear scale ranging from -27 to -22, with tick labels at intervals of 1. Each category on the horizontal axis is represented by a group of six bars: a light blue bar representing the base model "Mistralv0.2-Base", followed by five bars of different shades of orange and brown, representing the fine-tuned models in the order of Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The bars for Cardio range from approximately -26.5 for the base model to around -22.2 for the fine-tuned model on Cardio, while the bars for the other categories show similar patterns, with the base model generally having the lowest negative log probability and the fine-tuned models having higher values, with some variations. The bars within each group are not sorted in any particular order other than being arranged according to the legend, and none of the bars are visually emphasized. Overall, the chart illustrates how fine-tuning the model on different specialties affects the negative log probability of terms specific to those specialties.
